scripts.dev:db: docker compose -f docker-compose.db.yml up -d || docker-compose -f docker-compose.db.yml up -d
scripts.dev:db:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.db.yml down || docker-compose -f docker-compose.db.yml down
scripts.dev:db:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.db.yml logs -f || docker-compose -f docker-compose.db.yml logs -f
scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.clean: npm run clean:backend && npm run clean:frontend
scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm run install:all
scripts.docker:db: docker compose -f docker-compose.db.yml up -d || docker-compose -f docker-compose.db.yml up -d
scripts.docker:db:down: docker compose -f docker-compose.db.yml down || docker-compose -f docker-compose.db.yml down
scripts.docker:db:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.db.yml logs -f || docker-compose -f docker-compose.db.yml logs -f
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
